question: At what short segment lengths can these local models independently execute the sender and receiver roles under the frozen compact-KV message protocol?
purpose: Capability calibration only. This study does not rank message formats or claim protocol superiority. A later format comparison is eligible only if both model sender and model receiver controls reach exact success on the selected task region.
split: heldout, generated from fresh deterministic seeds after v0.10
message_condition: compact_kv: sender sends only s=<exact subtotal>
engine: Silo-Bench pinned upstream engine commit e74127782ed1c42fff474249961f022c063d76f2
runtime: llama.cpp b11202, commit fcb3074f2, Windows x64 CUDA 12.4, server at 127.0.0.1:8000
local_hardware_and_server: NVIDIA RTX 4060 8 GB, context size 8192, 99 GPU layers requested, temperature 0, 256-token generation cap; run one model server at a time. If either model cannot load these pinned settings, stop before scored inference and preregister a documented settings amendment.
decoding: temperature 0, reasoning off, max 4 interaction rounds, context size 8192
warmup: One unscored 'Reply with OK' backend request per model before scored episodes, matching the inherited v0.8 runner. Warmup is excluded from outcomes.
design: Four paired hybrid conditions, one greedy run for every task in every condition (96 episodes total). For each task and model, run both complementary oracle/model role assignments. Alternate role order by task index. Oracle agents are deterministic controls, not LLM outcomes.
primary_outcomes: Agent 0 exact local prefix segment in model-sender episodes, by segment length
Agent 0 subtotal message value fidelity in model-sender episodes, by segment length
Agent 1 exact global prefix segment among model-receiver episodes where the correct oracle subtotal was received before submission, by segment length
joint exact episode success, by model, role condition, and segment length
secondary_outcomes: message syntax, sends, delivery, and receipt
model backend input/output tokens, wall time, and interaction rounds
qualitative error categories from exact submissions and messages
frozen_predictions: Shorter segment lengths may improve at least one model role relative to the prior L=6/15/30 failures; no minimum improvement is assumed.

If receiver exactness remains low with a correct oracle subtotal delivered, length reduction alone is insufficient; inspect instruction/tool interaction and arithmetic strategy before protocol comparisons.
If both roles achieve exact success consistently at any length, that length defines a candidate operating region for a separately preregistered protocol study, not evidence of language superiority.
analysis: Report counts and denominators per length and role. Do not pool oracle performance into model accuracy. Do not interpret token or latency comparisons across these role variants as message-format efficiency. No inferential significance claim is planned for 8 cases per length.
limits: one greedy inference per task and condition; no estimate of decoding variance
24 generated tasks from one arithmetic task family; narrow construct validity
the two model checkpoints differ in scale and training, so scale is not isolated
hybrid roles measure component capability, not end-to-end all-model communication
all experiments use the same local runner, simulator, transport, and scorer
